Episode 144. For a Friend (7)
Dante couldn't take his eyes off the bluish sword energy that started from the far end of the rear for a while.

He didn't want to cowardly survive alone when his whole family had risked their lives, he wanted to prove that Hiran was Hiran even without his grandfather, and he didn't want to drag his friend into this quagmire.
However, the bluish sword energy he saw with his own eyes felt like a light cutting through despair.
Jin didn't receive Dante's letter.
Even if he did, he and his people would have certainly come to aid the Sword Emperor's castle.
Hiran!
We have arrived!
When Jin shouted with all his might, the entire battlefield vibrated with his voice. Dante, standing alone at the forefront of the battlefield, could hear his friend's voice clearly.
The Emperor's troops in the rear looked up. Jin was standing on the high cliff behind the Sword Emperor's castle.
"The Barmel Union and the Ticahn Kingdom will defend the Sword Emperor's castle with Hiran from this moment on."
The Thunder Sword Sigismund, a divine sword personally bestowed by the War God, was imbued with sharp thunder energy.
The gate of the dragon cannon targeting the rear gate was hastily turning towards Jin.
"So, all enemies should make way."
Kwaaaa-!
The moment the dragon cannon fired a shell, Jin's sword emitted light.
Runkandel's 5th Secret Technique
Lightspeed Thrust - Mingwang
The flash caused by a single sword brightened the dark night sky in an instant.
And the bullet from the dragon cannon disappeared without a trace, leaving only the echo and the mark of its launch.
It was swallowed by the lightspeed thrust.
The sword energy that swallowed the bullet went straight through the shields of the Emperor's knights and wizards and completely destroyed the dragon cannon.
It all happened before the echo had even fully dispersed in the air.
Those who saw it couldn't understand what had happened.
They only inferred that he had thrust his sword once, seeing Jin's movement and the remnants of the thunder and aura in a straight line between the cliff and the shattered dragon cannon.
But the shock didn't end there.
"Kwaaaak!"
"What, what is this...!"
Lightning began to pour out from the point of impact where the dragon cannon was shattered by the lightspeed thrust.

The original lightspeed thrust, as described by Talarius, was just a madly fast thrust. However, Jin's lightspeed thrust, named after his brothers, contained the wild energy characteristic of the Mingwang sword.
The ruthless power of the race that had conquered the world and dominated as the only loser.
The blue thunder energy was trampling on the knights and wizards of the Emperor's army.
They had no means to protect themselves from that power.
With a single sword strike, the rear ranks of the Emperor's army collapsed.
Friends and foes alike. They couldn't help but all have the same thought while shuddering at Jin's sword.
This is what a knight dominating the battlefield looks like.
Jin gathered his energy again.
And until the cliff couldn't support his power and crumbled, he continuously executed lightspeed thrusts.
The blue flashes falling on the battlefield seemed like divine punishment in the enemies' eyes.
As part of the Empire, it felt like they were paying the price for daring to betray Hiran.
As a human who had been safe within the barrier of Hiran, it felt like they were being punished for not standing against the Emperor's tyranny.
The cliff collapsed after the fifth lightspeed thrust was executed.
And the collapse of the cliff meant that now this monster would be directly sweeping the battlefield.
The fear of the enemies had to intensify heavily.
The Mingwang sword was created solely for conquest and destruction. No martial arts were more specialized for war in the world.
The moment Jin stepped onto the battlefield, the scale of death changed.

With the spread of thunder energy, the falling of lightning, and the pouring of thunder, every time, at least dozens, sometimes hundreds of enemies were killed or injured enough to not be able to fight anymore and rolled on the ground.
Even the knights of the Emperor's army, let alone ordinary knights, couldn't dare to block Jin's path. If they carelessly approached, they would burn to death even before they could cross swords.
Screams loud enough to make ears ring were spreading.
But Jin didn't hear their screams.
Only the rough voice of his friend, whose heart must have been torn in the madness of war, tore his chest.
"Back off, you bastards. How could you do this to Hiran...!"
Meanwhile, people were witnessing another name for Runkandel.
All the cannons, including the dragon cannon targeting the rear gate and all the cannons of the Yellow Dragon class and above, were tracking Jin's movements.
In the first place, the dragon cannon at the front where Dante was, was nothing but a distraction. There were far more dragon cannons placed in the rear and the flanks.
Over fifty dragon cannons were being loaded.
Also, the enemy commanders were regaining their senses and preparing for a combined attack.

"Jin Runkandel! Are you aware that the people you're killing are the troops of His Majesty, the Emperor of the Great Biment Empire? Runkandel, you're now intervening in the Empire's civil war, do you not understand what that means..."
The commander of the Lillistar Magic Corps couldn't finish his sentence.
Jin immediately executed another lightspeed thrust in the direction from which the voice came.

As soon as he died, the knights of the Central Knight Corps, including the knights who were among the main figures of the Emperor's army that Dante had previously thought of, formed ranks and blocked Jin.
Jin snorted.
"The fact that you can die by Runecandle on the battlefield, that would be the highest honor such trash like you can ever hope for."
The Central Knight Division did not add any other words, just like the commander of Rilistara.
They recognized it at a glance. The fact that no matter what they say, Jin will not stop.
"So, I generally don't even want to grant you guys that honor. Isn't that what happens when you forget your honor?"
As soon as Jin's words ended.
Boom-! Sizzle!
Suddenly, a cannonball fired from somewhere fell on the heads of the Central Knight Division.
It was a dragon spear bullet. The knights quickly raised a protective barrier and swung their swords, but the empire's largest-grade shell took away the lives of three of them.
'Damn it, why are the dragon spears targeting us!'
'There's no way the Hensek Magic Corps would make such a mistake. Could it be......!'
Jin coldly laughed and shrugged.
"I clearly shouted that it wasn't just me, but us who came. Did those who call themselves commanders forget that?"
Sizzle, Boom!
Dragon spear bullets continued to be fired at the Central Knight Division.
The figure aiming at the cannon from the rear battlefield on the left was not the Imperial Army.
"Direct hit! Hehe, the Lord will praise me?"
Amella, a mercenary, chuckled and loaded the next cannon.
As soon as she entered the battlefield, she began quickly seizing enemy equipment one by one.
"Balkas, sir. That. That looks useful too. Please get it for me."
"……All right."
"I'd rather have the cuties bring it to me, I wonder if our Prochi pretties are doing well on the side battlefield."
Black King Balkas and Mercenary Amella.
These two, who could be called the Gods of War, were also sweeping the rear battlefield with Jin.
The Imperial Army, who realized this fact belatedly, had to experience the horrifying sensation as if their vitality was draining from their heads.
Balkas effortlessly lifted up the dragon spear pointed out by Amella.
He raised the gigantic cannon led by a hundred ordinary knights as if it were a slightly heavy rock.
In front of humans who had reached the level of superhumans, the number of soldiers held no meaning.
"It's not as good as the magic absorption spray-type all-weather acceleration cannon, but it's not too bad. After the war, I'll take a few and hang them on Tikhan! Fire, fire!"
In the end, the dragon spears operated by Amella annihilated all the knights who blocked Jin's path before even thirty seconds had passed.
"Ch... Ah... Cough."
Jin did not even personally cut them down, as he had said.
He did not even leave them the honor of dying by the sword of Runcandel on the battlefield.
"Even in death, atone. Consider what you've done. And fervently hope that Dante does not die or get hurt. If that happens, I will annihilate not only your family but also all of your relatives..."
Upon hearing this, the knights of the Central Knights Division could not believe that this was the end, even in the face of death.
It was a deep, dark voice that no one could dismiss as bluff, the majesty of a pure-blooded Runcandel.
As Jin began to move again, the imperial soldiers around him stepped back.
Even though the plain was vast, it felt as if there was a cliff right behind them. It seemed like they would fall into it if they kept retreating to avoid Jin.
However, their steps would not move forward.
A vast shadow of fear, overshadowing even the Emperor's command and the madness of war, was approaching.
When they thought they were dealing with a Hi-Ran without Ron, all of the imperial troops were confident of victory.
In front of numerous dragons, knights, wizards, and the Empire's strongest war equipment, including Dragon Cannons, they thought that Sword Emperor City would ultimately fall.
That's why the imperial troops attacked Sword Emperor City, knowing that this purge was in no way justified.
Right or wrong, being on the losing side of a war will only result in death and destruction.
The moment they defend Hi-Ran, they too would become rebels and meet their end.
However, they overlooked the fact that Hi-Ran was not alone.
They failed to recognize the relationship between Hi-Ran's Zodiac Beast and the 12th generation Runcandel, which is thicker than blood.
That's why now, the imperial troops were overwhelmed by the certainty and despair that 'they cannot win'. Even beyond that, they had this question.
Can the Empire continue to exist as an Empire after today?
They wanted to confess their sins and beg to be on Hi-Ran's side now.
They wanted to express in a cowardly voice that they were simply weak and followed the Emperor's command, and in fact, they respected Hi-Ran more than the royal family.
There was no way Jin and Hi-Ran would accept that ridiculous story.
They knew best that the claim of merely following orders would not serve as any excuse.
Some of them ended up losing their minds and crying out, some dropped their weapons and shivered all over.
Some struggled, but that was not to fight the opponent, but because they had lost their sanity and turned into frightened beasts.
"I swear by the name of the 12th generation Runcandel. Run away, I will not chase you. But those who remain on the battlefield will die without exception. But in my opinion..."
You would probably prefer to die here than to endure a lifetime of shame and guilt.
Jin continued his words, glaring at his enemies.
Those who saw his gaze realized to their bones.
Whether they confront or run away, there is nothing but hell.
